pashtoLocale.label: Swat / Dir / Malakand Pashto
pashtoLocale.register: Everyday speech for a child; short singular instructions

romanization.style: Practical informal Roman Pashto, not IPA
notes: Use kh for the local pronunciation of ښ and g for ږ where appropriate.
Use z for ځ and s for څ in this northern conversational reading aid.
Use zama, bya, school and kitaab consistently.
Romanization is a reading aid; it does not replace the English word or claim a universal spelling standard.

sources.scope: Attested use of سکول in a report about a Swat school; not validation of the whole course.
Search-indexed lexical variation study identifies Kashmiry for tomato among Swat speakers; use alongside ټماټر, not as the only valid regional word.
Dictionary marks پۍ as an Eastern word for milk; not proof that every family prefers it.
Dictionary includes الو among potato variants.

welcome.ps: ستا نوی سفر له دې ځایه شروع کېږي.
welcome.rps: Sta naway safar la de zaaya shuru kegi.
welcome.ur: آپ کا اگلا سفر یہیں سے شروع ہوتا ہے۔
welcome.rur: Aap ka agla safar yaheen se shuru hota hai.

ready.ur: کچھ نیا سیکھنے کے لیے تیار؟
ready.rur: Kuch naya seekhne ke liye tayyar?

growing.ps: وګوره، څومره څه دې زده کړل!
growing.rps: Wagora, somra sa de zda kral!
growing.ur: دیکھیں، آپ کتنا سیکھ رہے ہیں!
growing.rur: Dekhein, aap kitna seekh rahe hain!

games.ps: لوبې وکړه، نوي څه زده کړه
games.rps: Lobey wakra, nawe sa zda kra

spelling.en: Spelling, one little step at a time
spelling.ps: املا په لږ لږ مشق زده کړه
spelling.rps: Imla pa lag lag mashq zda kra
spelling.ur: تھوڑی تھوڑی مشق سے ہجے سیکھیں
spelling.rur: Thori thori mashq se hijjay seekhein

letters.en: Look at each letter. These are letter names, not separate speech sounds.
letters.ps: هر توری وګوره. د توري نوم او اواز یو شان نه دي.
letters.rps: Har toray wagora. Da tori noom aw aawaaz yaw shaan na di.
letters.ur: ہر حرف دیکھیں۔ حرف کا نام اور آواز ایک جیسے نہیں ہوتے۔
letters.rur: Har harf dekhein. Harf ka naam aur aawaz aik jaisay nahin hotay.

build.en: Tap the letters to build the word. Tap a placed letter to undo it.
build.ps: توري یو په بل پسې کېږده او لفظ جوړ کړه.
build.rps: Tori yaw pa bal pase kegda aw lafz jor kra.
build.ur: حروف ترتیب سے رکھ کر لفظ بنائیں۔
build.rur: Huroof tarteeb se rakh kar lafz banayein.

dictation.en: Listen, then spell the word without looking.
dictation.ps: اواز واوره، بیا لفظ بې له کتلو ولیکه.
dictation.rps: Aawaaz waawra, bya lafz be la katlo walika.
dictation.ur: آواز سنیں، پھر دیکھے بغیر لفظ لکھیں۔
dictation.rur: Aawaz sunein, phir dekhay baghair lafz likhein.

sentence.ps: راځه چې پوره جمله جوړه کړو.
sentence.rps: Raaza che poora jumla jora kro.

copy.en: Read the sentence, then write it yourself.
copy.ps: جمله ولوله، بیا یې خپله ولیکه.
copy.rps: Jumla walola, bya ye khpala walika.

capital.en: Start with a capital letter. Use a capital I for yourself.
capital.ps: جمله په لوی توري شروع کړه. د ځان لپاره I تل لوی لیکه.
capital.rps: Jumla pa loy tori shuru kra. Da zaan dapaara I tal loy lika.
capital.ur: جملہ بڑے حرف سے شروع کریں۔ اپنے لیے I ہمیشہ بڑا لکھیں۔
capital.rur: Jumla baray harf se shuru karein. Apne liye I hamesha bara likhein.

punctuation.en: A statement ends with a full stop. A question ends with a question mark.
punctuation.ps: د خبرې په اخر کې ټکی او د سوال په اخر کې د سوال نښه لګوه.
punctuation.rps: Da khabare pa aakhar ke takay aw da sawaal pa aakhar ke da sawaal nakha lagawa.
punctuation.ur: بات کے آخر میں نقطہ، سوال کے آخر میں سوالیہ نشان لگائیں۔
punctuation.rur: Baat ke aakhir mein nuqta, sawaal ke aakhir mein sawaliya nishaan lagayein.

read.en: Tap a word to hear it. Read the whole sentence again.
read.ps: په لفظ ګوته کېږده او اواز یې واوره. بیا پوره جمله ولوله.
read.rps: Pa lafz gwata kegda aw aawaaz ye waawra. Bya poora jumla walola.
read.ur: لفظ پر دبائیں اور سنیں، پھر پورا جملہ پڑھیں۔
read.rur: Lafz par dabayein aur sunein, phir poora jumla parhein.

retry.en: A little more practice. Look at the correction, then try again.
retry.ps: لږ نور مشق وکړه. صحیح جواب وګوره، بیا کوشش وکړه.
retry.rps: Lag nor mashq wakra. Sahih jawaab wagora, bya koshish wakra.
retry.ur: تھوڑی اور مشق کریں۔ صحیح جواب دیکھ کر دوبارہ کوشش کریں۔
retry.rur: Thori aur mashq karein. Sahih jawaab dekh kar dobara koshish karein.

family.en: These words share an ending. Listen to what stays the same.
family.ps: د دې لفظونو اخري اواز یو شان دی. اوازونه یې واوره.
family.rps: Da de lafzuno aakhri aawaaz yaw shaan day. Aawaazuna ye waawra.
family.ur: ان لفظوں کی آخری آواز ایک جیسی ہے۔ سن کر ملائیں۔
family.rur: In lafzon ki aakhri aawaz aik jaisi hai. Sun kar milayein.

adventureHelp.en: Watch and listen. Then tap an answer. You can ask for a hint and try again.
adventureHelp.ps: وګوره او واوره. بیا په جواب ګوته کېږده. که نه پوهېږې، مدد وغواړه او بیا کوشش وکړه.
adventureHelp.rps: Wagora aw waawra. Bya pa jawaab gwata kegda. Ka na pohege, madad waghwaara aw bya koshish wakra.
adventureHelp.ur: دیکھیں اور سنیں، پھر جواب پر دبائیں۔ اشارہ لے کر دوبارہ کوشش کر سکتے ہیں۔
adventureHelp.rur: Dekhein aur sunein, phir jawab par dabayein. Ishara le kar dobara koshish kar sakte hain.

instructions: Review English meaning, natural Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pashto, Roman Pashto consistency, Urdu and Roman Urdu. Add corrections and reviewer notes. This export is for review; changes must be applied to the source modules and tested before release.

phrases.rur: Barah e karam meri madad karein.

phrases.ur: کیا میں اندر آ سکتا ہوں؟
phrases.rur: Kya main andar aa sakta hoon?

phrases.ps: مهرباني وکړه، خپل کتاب خلاص کړه.
phrases.rps: Mehrabani wakra, khpal kitaab khlaas kra.
phrases.rur: Barah e karam apni kitab kholein.

readings.ur: مجھے ایک مچھلی نظر آتی ہے۔
readings.rur: Mujhe aik machhli nazar aati hai.

readings.en: The cat is on the chair.

phonics: A short /æ/: open your mouth wide. The letter name A is different from this sound.
Bring your lips forward. Let air flow: sh.
Start with a stop, then release air: ch.
Put the tip of your tongue gently between your teeth and blow air.
Use the same tongue position, with a gentle vibration in your throat.
For v, touch your lower lip with your top teeth. For w, round your lips.
Ship has a short relaxed vowel. Sheep has a longer /iː/ sound.
Say the sounds /k/, /æ/, /t/ slowly, then join them to make cat. Letter names and sounds are different.
Short e /e/: relax your mouth and listen to the middle sound.
Short i /ɪ/: keep the vowel short and relaxed.
Short o /ɒ/ in British English: round your open lips. Accents vary.
Short u /ʌ/: open your mouth a little.
In these pairs, the final e is silent and the a sound changes. This pattern has exceptions.
The silent e changes short i /ɪ/ to /aɪ/ in these words.
The two letters ph often spell the single sound /f/.
These are blends: keep both consonant sounds as you join them.

phonicsSupport.en: Open your mouth for the short a sound.
phonicsSupport.ps: د لنډ a اواز لپاره خوله خلاصه کړه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Da land a aawaaz dapaara khwla khlaasa kra.
phonicsSupport.ur: چھوٹی اَ کی آواز کے لیے منہ کھولیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Chhoti a ki aawaz ke liye munh kholein.

phonicsSupport.en: Push your lips forward and let air out.
phonicsSupport.ps: شونډې لږې مخې ته کړه او هوا وباسه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Shundey lagey makhe ta kra aw hawa wabaasa.
phonicsSupport.ur: ہونٹ آگے کریں اور ہوا نکالیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Hont aagay karein aur hawa nikalein.

phonicsSupport.en: Stop the air, then release it.
phonicsSupport.ps: هوا لږه بنده کړه، بیا یې پرېږده.
phonicsSupport.rps: Hawa laga banda kra, bya ye pregda.

phonicsSupport.en: Put your tongue gently between your teeth.
phonicsSupport.ps: د ژبې سر د غاښونو منځ کې لږ کېږده.
phonicsSupport.rps: Da jibey sar da ghaakhuno manz ke lag kegda.
phonicsSupport.ur: زبان آہستہ دانتوں کے درمیان رکھیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Zaban aahista daanton ke darmiyan rakhein.

phonicsSupport.en: Use your voice with the same tongue position.
phonicsSupport.ps: ژبه همداسې وساته او اواز وباسه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Jiba hamdaase wasaata aw aawaaz wabaasa.
phonicsSupport.ur: زبان اسی طرح رکھیں اور آواز نکالیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Zaban isi tarah rakhein aur aawaz nikalein.

phonicsSupport.en: Listen to v and w. Watch your lips.
phonicsSupport.ps: د v او w اوازونه واوره. خپلو شونډو ته پام کوه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Da v aw w aawaazuna waawra. Khpalo shundo ta paam kawa.
phonicsSupport.ur: وی اور ڈبلیو سنیں۔ اپنے ہونٹوں پر دھیان دیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: V aur W sunein. Apne honton par dhyan dein.

phonicsSupport.en: Listen: ship is short; sheep is longer.
phonicsSupport.ps: په ship کې د منځ اواز لنډ دی، په sheep کې اوږد دی.
phonicsSupport.rps: Pa ship ke da manz aawaaz land day, pa sheep ke oogd day.
phonicsSupport.ur: سنیں: شِپ کی آواز چھوٹی، شیپ کی لمبی ہے۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Sunein: ship ki aawaz chhoti, sheep ki lambi hai.

phonicsSupport.en: Say the sounds, then join them.
phonicsSupport.ps: اوازونه ووایه، بیا یې سره یو ځای کړه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Aawaazuna wawaaya, bya ye sara yaw zaay kra.

phonicsSupport.en: Listen to the middle sound in bed and pen.
phonicsSupport.ps: په bed او pen کې د منځ اواز واوره.
phonicsSupport.rps: Pa bed aw pen ke da manz aawaaz waawra.
phonicsSupport.ur: بیڈ اور پین کی درمیانی آواز سنیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Bed aur pen ki darmiyani aawaz sunein.

phonicsSupport.en: Open your mouth and round your lips.
phonicsSupport.ps: خوله خلاصه کړه او شونډې ګردې کړه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Khwla khlaasa kra aw shundey girdey kra.
phonicsSupport.ur: منہ کھولیں اور ہونٹ گول کریں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Munh kholein aur hont gol karein.

phonicsSupport.en: Listen to sun, cup and bus.
phonicsSupport.ps: د sun، cup او bus اوازونه واوره.
phonicsSupport.rps: Da sun, cup aw bus aawaazuna waawra.
phonicsSupport.ur: سن، کپ اور بس کی آوازیں سنیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Sun, cup aur bus ki aawazein sunein.

phonicsSupport.en: The last e is silent in cape. Listen to the change.
phonicsSupport.ps: په cape کې اخري e نه وایو. د a اواز ته غوږ ونیسه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Pa cape ke aakhri e na waayu. Da a aawaaz ta ghwag wanisa.
phonicsSupport.ur: کیپ میں آخری ای خاموش ہے۔ فرق سنیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Cape mein aakhri e khamosh hai. Farq sunein.

phonicsSupport.en: Compare kit and kite. Listen to the vowel.
phonicsSupport.ps: kit او kite واوره. د منځ اواز یې یو شان نه دی.
phonicsSupport.rps: Kit aw kite waawra. Da manz aawaaz ye yaw shaan na day.
phonicsSupport.ur: کٹ اور کائٹ کا فرق سنیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Kit aur kite ka farq sunein.

phonicsSupport.en: Two letters can make one sound.
phonicsSupport.ps: کله کله دوه توري یو اواز ورکوي.
phonicsSupport.rps: Kala kala dwa tori yaw aawaaz warkawi.
phonicsSupport.ur: دو حروف ایک آواز بنا سکتے ہیں۔
phonicsSupport.rur: Do huroof aik aawaz bana saktay hain.

phonicsSupport.en: Join the sounds and say the word.
phonicsSupport.ps: اوازونه سره یو ځای کړه او لفظ ووایه.
phonicsSupport.rps: Aawaazuna sara yaw zaay kra aw lafz wawaaya.

grammarLessons.tip: Use am with I.
Use is with he, she or it.
Use are with you, we or they.
Use have with I, you, we or they.
Use has with he, she or it.
Use a before a consonant sound: a cat.
Use an before a vowel sound: an apple. Listen to the sound, not just the letter.
Many nouns add s for more than one: book → books. Some change differently: child → children.
This points to one thing near you.
That points to one thing farther away.
These points to more than one thing near you.
Those points to more than one thing farther away.
Use this for something you do regularly. He goes; I go.
Yesterday is before today. Play becomes played for the past.
Tomorrow is after today. Will helps talk about the future.
Add not after am, is or are to say no.
A question asks something. End a written question with ?.

grammarLessons.en: The cat is in the box.
grammarLessons.tip: In means inside. The cat is inside the box.

grammarLessons.en: The book is on the chair.
grammarLessons.tip: On tells us that something rests on a surface.
My tells us something belongs to me. Your tells us it belongs to you.
Red describes the ball. Big and small also describe things.

lines.en: He shares the apples with his family.
lines.ps: هغه مڼې د خپل کور د خلکو سره وېشي.
lines.rps: Hagha maney da khpal kor da khalko sara weshi.
lines.ur: وہ سیب اپنے گھر والوں کے ساتھ بانٹتا ہے۔
lines.rur: Woh saib apne ghar walon ke saath baantta hai.

questions.prompt: How many apples does Ali buy?

lines.ur: سارہ کے پاس لال بستہ ہے۔
lines.rur: Sara ke paas laal basta hai.

lines.en: She puts a book in her bag.
lines.ps: هغه په خپل بکس کې کتاب ږدي.
lines.rps: Hagha pa khpal baks ke kitaab gdi.
lines.ur: وہ اپنے بستے میں کتاب رکھتی ہے۔
lines.rur: Woh apne bastay mein kitab rakhti hai.

lines.en: Ali and Sara go to the park.
lines.ps: علي او سارا پارک ته ځي.
lines.rps: Ali aw Sara park ta zi.
lines.ur: علی اور سارہ پارک جاتے ہیں۔
lines.rur: Ali aur Sara park jatay hain.

lines.ur: وہ درخت کے نیچے بیٹھتے ہیں۔
lines.rur: Woh darakht ke neechay baithtay hain.

lines.en: Ali washes his hands with soap and water.
lines.ps: علي خپل لاسونه په صابون او اوبو وینځي.
lines.rps: Ali khpal laasuna pa saabun aw obo winzi.
lines.ur: علی صابن اور پانی سے ہاتھ دھوتا ہے۔
lines.rur: Ali sabun aur pani se haath dhota hai.

lines.ps: اوس د هغه لاسونه پاک دي.
lines.rps: Os da hagha laasuna paak di.
lines.ur: اب اس کے ہاتھ صاف ہیں۔
lines.rur: Ab us ke haath saaf hain.

lines.ur: سارہ ایک چھوٹا پرندہ دیکھتی ہے۔
lines.rur: Sara aik chhota parinda dekhti hai.

lines.en: She puts water in a bowl.
lines.ps: هغه په پیاله کې اوبه اچوي.
lines.rps: Hagha pa pyaala ke oba achawi.
lines.ur: وہ پیالے میں پانی ڈالتی ہے۔
lines.rur: Woh piyalay mein pani daalti hai.

questions.prompt: What does she put in the bowl?

lines.en: The fox sees a little star.
lines.ur: لومڑی ایک چھوٹا ستارہ دیکھتی ہے۔
lines.rur: Lomri aik chhota sitara dekhti hai.

lines.en: He helps the star find its way home.
lines.ps: هغه ستوري ته د کور لاره ښيي.
lines.rps: Hagha stori ta da kor laara khayi.
lines.ur: وہ ستارے کو گھر کا راستہ ڈھونڈنے میں مدد کرتا ہے۔
lines.rur: Woh sitaray ko ghar ka raasta dhoondnay mein madad karta hai.
